name: SAP ABAP Developer
title: SAP ABAP Developer
description: Comprehensive ABAP engineering curriculum. Covers procedural and Object-Oriented ABAP, Data Dictionary, modern Open SQL syntax, CDS Views, ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP), Enhancement Framework (BAdIs, User Exits), ALV Grid, and modern ABAP Cloud syntax rules.

levels.title: Level 0 — ABAP Core & Data Dictionary (DDIC)
levels.description: Syntax fundamentals, elementary types, structures, internal tables, and Data Dictionary objects (Tables, Views, Data Elements).

subjects.title: Data Dictionary & Internal Tables
subjects.description: Core subject domain covering Data Dictionary & Internal Tables.

topics.title: Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types
topics.description: Build robust database tables, data elements, domains, structures, and search helps.
learningObjectives: Understand internal architecture and core mechanics of Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types
Implement production-grade components using industry best practices for Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types
Diagnose runtime errors, misconfigurations, and edge cases in Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types
Explain design trade-offs and answer senior technical interview questions on Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types

learningItems.title: Data Dictionary Objects: Domains, Data Elements, Structures, Database Tables (SE11)
Primary Keys, Foreign Key Relationships & Value Tables
Elementary Data Types, Variables & String Manipulation in ABAP
Internal Tables: Standard Tables, Sorted Tables, Hashed Tables & Performance Trade-Offs
Table Operations: APPEND, INSERT, MODIFY, DELETE, READ TABLE with Keys, LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS

practice.title: Hands-on Lab: Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types
practice.description: Implement, test, and validate core patterns of Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types in a realistic workspace environment.

practice.title: Independent Challenge: Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types
practice.description: Build end-to-end functionality for Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types from scratch and verify production error handling.

debugging.title: Diagnose & Resolve Production Issue in Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types
debugging.description: Troubleshoot a scenario where Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types throws unexpected exceptions or fails under high load / invalid payload.

How do you diagnose and fix performance bottlenecks or security vulnerabilities when working with Data Dictionary (SE11) & ABAP Data Types?

Constructors, Class-Methods vs Instance-Methods

Class-Based Exception Handling (TRY ... CATCH cx_root ... ENDTRY)
